speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. You mentioned waking up frightened; can you describe exactly what happens during these episodes? Are you scared of something specific, or do you feel a sense of pressure?

Also, how many times a week does this occur, and has it been happening for a few months or longer?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is very helpful. Does she ever recall any dreams during these frightening episodes, or does she wake up without any specific memory of what happened? Also, do these episodes happen specifically during the first half of the night or later on?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination.
